verdict.rationale: Alma is a technology-enabled immigration law firm that handles sensitive client data and draws on 'case intelligence pulled from hundreds of prior filings', so asking whether client data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no privacy policy, data-use terms, or AI-training opt-out; it covers only visa guides, pricing, turnaround times and site probes. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
